description: This file contains the implementation of the CacheManagerImpl class, which manages caching operations using Infinispan, including initialization of TreeCache instances and interaction with vendor cache managers.

classes.name: CacheManagerImpl
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for caching management using Infinispan, including methods to initialize caches and access cache managers and tree caches.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the tree cache with a given cache name, setting up the cache configuration and handling exceptions.

methods.name: getManager
methods.description: Returns the EmbeddedCacheManager instance from the vendor cache manager.

methods.name: getTreeCache
methods.description: Returns the TreeCache instance managed by this class.
